title: 🐛 v0.5.02 · Bug fixes
md:
This version fixes several displays and trades in the new region, and adjusts a few settings.

## 🐛 Bug fixes
• Trainer card: the new region's badges now show. Earning one of its badges shows the right badge.
• The close cross shows again on the Trainer card, the Guide, the Tastes, the Changelogs and the team picker of raids and legendary zones.
• Trades: a Pokémon from an older region received in the new region's tab no longer counts as coming from the new region. The Pokémon concerned get their home region back.

## ⚖️ Balance
• Moves: moves with 100 power or more are now learned at the same level as TMs of the same power: Lv. 65 up to 110, Lv. 85 above.
• Hyper Beam, Giga Impact and the other recharge moves are no longer learned.
• The new region's second Gym is less difficult.
• Encounters from rustling grass, dust clouds, shadows and ripples in the new region are rebalanced.

## 🧭 Quality of life
• Daily shiny raid: you can redraw from the banner as long as you haven't started the raid. The game warns you before you start it.

To report a bug: the #bugs channel on the Discord, or Options › Community › « Report a bug » on phone.

title: 🐛 v0.5.01 · Bug fixes
md:
This version fixes access to the new region.

## 🐛 Bug fixes
• New region: trainers who had finished the fourth region's after-League story before the update could not leave for it. The departure is now open.
• The lock now names the right place to finish.

To report a bug: the #bugs channel on the Discord, or Options › Community › « Report a bug » on phone.

title: 🗺️ v0.5.0 · New region
md:
This version opens a new region, reopens online play to every country, brings natures back as Tastes, adds a daily boss, fully reworks trades and stops watching your game.

## 🗺️ New region
• It opens after the fourth region's League: new Pokémon, new Gyms, a League, and more after the League.
• Like the previous one, it has its own money, Bag and team until its League. Beating it links both sides.
• Its own legendary and Élite zones, cinematics, trainer looks, achievements and avatar frames. We'll let you discover the rest.

## 🌍 Open to every country
• Online play is open again to new accounts from every country, no exceptions. Welcome, everyone!

## 🔁 Trades
The game checks these rules on every trade. When a trade is refused, it tells you why, and how long to wait when it's a matter of time.
For every trade:
• Both Pokémon must be of the same rarity: Common, Uncommon or Rare (the colour of the glow around the tile).
• Legendary and Mythical Pokémon can't be traded.
• You can only trade Pokémon from regions you have reached.
• Posting an offer is free: whoever accepts it pays the fee. Fees already paid for an offer online are given back to you.
On top of that, for shinies:
• 1 shiny trade per day (Paris time). It counts for both trainers as soon as a shiny changes hands, whether you give it or receive it. Your counter shows before you confirm. Once your trade of the day is done, your other shiny offers are paused until the next day.
• To give a shiny, your account must be older than 3 days and have at least 8 badges.
• A shiny can be given 24 h after it arrives in your game, whether caught, hatched or received in a trade. The game shows the time left.
• To receive a shiny, you must already have had its normal form (caught, hatched or received).
• A shiny never goes back to a trainer who already had it.
• A shiny whose origin doesn't add up stays in your game, but can't be traded.
The trade board:
• Two tabs, Normal and Shiny, and a Friends filter.
• A Pokémon's offers open in a side panel, without leaving the board.
• The Shiny tab shows your shiny trade of the day. Once it's done, it tells you when offers come back.
• “Mystery shiny”, first in the Shiny tab: offer a shiny for any shiny of the same rarity you're missing.
• Townspeople's requests appear on the board, with a blue frame. A species you have never seen shows as a silhouette.
• Tapping an offer you can't accept explains why.
• New confirmation window, with both trainers, their Pokémon and a Link cable between them.
• If you don't have enough money to accept an offer, the game shows how much you're short.

## 🍬 Tastes
• Natures come back as Tastes, once the new region is reached.
• Each Pokémon has a taste it likes and a taste it dislikes, hidden (“???”) until you give it a Rainbow Pokéblock: its liked stat gains 10%, its disliked stat loses 20%.
• Coloured Pokéblocks then raise its liked taste, up to +20%: Spicy raises Attack, Sour Defense, Dry Sp. Atk, Bitter Sp. Def, Sweet Speed. HP never changes.
• A Pokéblock of another taste shifts the liked taste to the new one, and the game tells you what it dislikes from now on. 2 raised stats at most.
• A new Rainbow Pokéblock redraws the tastes: the Pokéblocks already given are lost.
• Pokéblocks cost 20 Battle Points at the Battle Tower counter and have their own group in the Bag.
• Tastes count in every battle your Pokémon fight, Tower, Fabrique and legendary zones included, never for opponents.
• A traded Pokémon goes back to “???”.

## 🧁 Pokéblock Boss
• A new banner in Raids, open after your victory at the new region's League.
• One attack a day, with a team of 10 Pokémon, until the boss strikes back.
• Each day, a hungry boss and a taste of the day, the same for everyone. The boss likes that taste: its stat gains 20%. Its types count: “Optimize” picks the right attackers.
• Each milestone makes it grow and bursts out Pokéblocks of the day's taste, 15 a day at most. At rank V, it drops a Rainbow Pokéblock.
• Three avatar frames reward your record.

## 🎲 Raids
• Shiny raids: once a day, on the draw's result, you can spin the wheel again (from two Leagues won). The drawn region is left out, and the second draw is final.
• No more wild shinies on the way to a raid or a legendary zone: only the boss can be caught there.
• Raids screen: the Battle Tower is always at the bottom.

## 🥚 Day Care
• An Egg hatches in 6 h instead of 4.
• A shiny parent gives a shiny Egg 1 time in 16 instead of 1 in 10. Eggs already laid keep their odds.
• New berry: the Belue Berry, eaten by Ditto, doubles the next Egg's odds (1 in 8 with a shiny parent). Found in chests and at the Tower counter.
• The park's weather opens on its next 24 hours, like the adventure's.

## ⚔️ Battles
• Moves: each Pokémon learns the best of its moves from every official game, plus its types' TM moves, always from the weakest to the strongest as it levels up.
• 100 new moves, and 9 animations of their own for the strongest (Draco Meteor, Solar Blade, Triple Axel…).
• Every Pokémon's HP goes up by 10%, yours and your opponents' alike.

## 🛡️ No more watching your game
• The game no longer watches your save: no more “Unusual activity detected”, no more V-XXXX reference. Current holds are lifted.
• Only trades are still checked (see Trades).

## 💾 Save
• Your game goes online every 2 h while you play, when you leave the page and before each trade.
• Options › Save: “Export my game” creates a file to keep, “Import a game” puts it back in this browser.
• No game can be restored by hand anymore: export yours from time to time.

## 🧭 Quality of life
• Guide: the first time you reach a feature (Team, Pokédex, Day Care, Trades, Shop, Game Corner, Underground, Raids, Tastes…), its Guide page opens, with a link to the full Guide.
• Pokédex, PC and trades: a glow in each tile's corner shows the Pokémon's rarity.
• Map: “Restart” next to “Continue” on the current chapter, the League from its first room.
• Underground: the PC shows the floor an expedition is on.
• Underground: a shiny wears its star in a gem's “Can rank up” list.
• Élite frames redrawn for Groudon, Kyogre, Heatran, Uxie, Mesprit, Azelf, Cresselia, Darkrai, Raikou, Entei and Suicune: their effects follow the frame's ring.
• Support the creator: two buttons, Ko-fi or another payment method (bank card, Alipay…).

## ⚖️ Balance
• The fourth region's quest items are found 2 times in 100 instead of 1.
• Rotom's forms appear 10 times in 100 instead of 4, when their conditions are met.
• While you're away, you find twice as many items: 50% of what you find while playing, instead of 25%.

## 🐛 Bug fixes
• Time away in a League already won: the team moves on to the next member instead of going back to the first room.
• Battle: after a trip to the Underground, Pokémon no longer turn invisible and a boss's intro no longer freezes.
• Unown B to ?: translated, animated, shown in the PC's region filter, and their family counts 1 / 1.
• Pokédex: dragging an unseen Pokémon's silhouette no longer shows its picture.
• Trades: an accepted offer no longer gives the received Pokémon twice.

To report a bug: the #bugs channel on the Discord, or Options › Community › « Report a bug » on phone.
